book_title: Kelisa's Adventures: Book 1: The Road to Castle Wyegates
author: Karen L.  West
book_description: Embark on an epic journey with Kelisa and her younger brother, Tif, as they're cast out of their village and thrust into a world of danger, ancient secrets, and magical creatures. With only their wits, courage, and a mysterious legacy to guide them, they must navigate treacherous forests, forge unlikely alliances, and discover their true destinies. Will they survive the trails ahead and unlock the power within to change their world forever?How do they survive? Will the cadets Kelisa is training with support her and Tif? What are the Tarktos and Kahti?Show more
